steps.zh: 装上这个 Go 单文件程序

steps.en: Run one setup command per agent, then restart that agent
steps.zh: 每个 agent 跑一条 setup 命令，再重启它

steps.en: Registers its MCP server and hands the agent a memory protocol: when to save, when to search
steps.zh: 注册 MCP 服务，并给 agent 一份记忆规程：何时存、何时查

steps.en: Work as usual: fix bugs, make decisions, end the session
steps.zh: 照常干活：修 bug、做决定、结束会话

steps.en: The agent saves curated notes and a session summary; Engram de-duplicates and indexes them
steps.zh: agent 存下精炼笔记和会话总结，Engram 去重并建索引

steps.en: Open a new session, in the same or another agent
steps.zh: 开新会话，同一个或换一个 agent 都行

steps.en: Brings back prior context: injected by the plugin, or fetched by the agent
steps.zh: 找回之前的上下文：插件自动注入，或由 agent 主动查

value.en: The next session, in any MCP agent, starts from what was learned instead of from zero
value.zh: 下一个会话不管用哪家 agent，都从已学到的东西接着干，不再从零开始
